visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a black crop top and light blue jeans, stands in an outdoor urban plaza at night. She speaks directly to the camera with various facial expressions including smiles and thoughtful looks. The background features colorful graffiti art on walls and distant street lights. (2) The woman stands inside a large, transparent display box designed to look like a life-sized action figure or toy package with 'MUSCLE HIGH' branding. She poses playfully with her arms raised. (3) The scene shifts to a stage performance where several muscular men with bare chests and blue jeans perform a choreographed dance under vibrant pink and blue stage lighting. The camera cuts back to the woman in the audience who reacts with wide eyes, laughter, and covers her mouth with her hands in excitement. (4) A male dancer wearing glasses and a white towel around his neck approaches the camera closely, smiling and gesturing. A hand from off-screen is seen touching the dancer's pectoral muscles while the main woman points and laughs in the background. (5) Back in the outdoor nighttime setting, the woman walks away from the camera, looking back to speak and point while laughing. The plaza is dimly lit with string lights and some outdoor seating visible in the background.
